$comment: THE ONE PLACE that says where every shipped throwable cue came from and under what licence. Edit this, then run `node scripts/audio/build-throwable-cues.mjs --sources <dir>` (needs ffmpeg). It writes public/sounds/throwables/<cue>.webm + .m4a, public/sounds/throwables/CREDITS.md and src/throwables/cueManifest.generated.ts. A `placeholder` cue has no file yet and names the legacy ThrowableSoundService recipe to play in its place; tests/unit/throwableCuesAreLicensed.test.ts counts them and refuses any licence not in `allowedLicenses`. Plan: docs/throwables/THROWABLES-PREMIUM-ANIMATION-PLAN.md 3.3.1.

pop_soft.$comment: beer: mug 2 pops in (reference: a soft pop, centroid ~1.9 kHz).

glass_clink_rattle.$comment: beer + champagne: the reference chime has six rattles at 0 / 133 / 380 / 466 / 600 / 733 ms and a 1.3 s ring-down. Built from five glass impacts layered at those offsets with decaying gain, plus the interface 'glass' tone underneath for the ring.

drip_tick.$comment: cracked_egg: the faint tick as the white drips.

squirt_start.$comment: water_gun: the first squirt. Needs a Freesound CC0 water-pistol take (phase 6).

squirt_loop.$comment: water_gun: 2.5 s pump + hiss loop. Needs a Freesound CC0 take (phase 6).

splat_wet.$comment: tomato + poop: one wet splat 33 ms after the visual burst. Needs a Freesound CC0 take (phase 6).

egg_crack.$comment: cracked_egg: the crack. Needs a Freesound CC0 take (phase 6).
